items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: Then I had a fellow named Shermie playing cornet with me out of the Edward Waters College there in the Jacksonville concert band.

ctx.x: around Florida and North Carolina, even further north, had you come across any style like that? Well- Is there a difference in the Louisiana style, say, and the other east?

Very, very different. Very different. There was no style, nowhere in the United States similar to the style of the playing of the fellas around in lower Louisiana and especially New Orleans. They had variations on the theme, whatever the number was. They had such variations on such wide variety of variations, until it would astound you. Yeah, it did me when I first started. Yes, that's just the truth. Now in places like Jacksonville, we had wonderful musicians around Jacksonville, like Tony Jackson and Connie…
Anytime you want to answer the phone or anything, we can always stop.
